name: ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system: evidence by Annex A domain
description: ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system: evidence by Annex A domain. From the Shio policy pack specification; draft, not reviewed.
limits: Draft and unreviewed. Planned controls are listed for coverage and not enforced.

frameworks.title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (guidance; certification needs an accredited auditor)

controls.title: Policies related to AI
controls.requirement: Policies related to AI, with owner and review date.

controls.title: Internal organisation
controls.requirement: Internal organisation: roles and reporting lines from the compliance context.

controls.title: Resources
controls.requirement: Resources: inventory of models, data, tools and people from the agent card.

controls.title: Impact assessment and its refresh dates
controls.requirement: Impact assessment and its refresh dates.

controls.title: Life cycle
controls.requirement: Life cycle: change records, replay results, pinned versions, release approvals.

controls.title: Data provenance
controls.requirement: Data provenance, quality checks, PHI and consent labels.

controls.title: Information for interested parties
controls.requirement: Information for interested parties: model cards, disclosures, incident channel.

controls.title: Use of AI
controls.requirement: Use of AI: oversight records, hold and sign-off logs, intended-use checks.

controls.title: Third parties
controls.requirement: Third parties: provider agreements, subprocessor lists, supplier reviews.
